assumptions.warmup: Use overnight signal state; reversal counting begins at 03:00
assumptions.qualification: Observed TrendOvershootExtended; no additional extension minimum
assumptions.entry: Second progressive reversal (ordinary or overshoot); next observed tick price
assumptions.resets: New published extreme resets reversal count; DC starts a new excursion; Trending ignored
assumptions.stop: Frozen published extreme; first reaching/crossing trade price; conservative priority on gaps
assumptions.profit_exit: Next same-trend overshoot extended after trade-direction DC; next observed tick price
assumptions.fallback_exit: Return/touch across DC confirmation price; first observed crossing tick; no exit on DC tick itself
assumptions.flatten: Scheduled 15:45 exit marked at last trade observable at/before cutoff
assumptions.limits: One position, one attempt per excursion; no fees, spread, liquidity, latency or risk-budget simulation
